name: ai-code-skills
description: A collection of Agent Skills for Claude Code and Codex that review code for security, performance, and clean code. Includes Next.js/React and Laravel/PHP PR reviewers and a stack-agnostic pre-push local reviewer; pick which skills to install.

scripts.test: node bin/cli.js list >/dev/null && node bin/cli.js --help >/dev/null && python3 skills/nextjs-pr-review/scripts/validate-report.py --self-test && python3 skills/laravel-pr-review/scripts/validate-report.py --self-test && python3 skills/pre-push-review/scripts/validate-report.py --self-test

author: Ezzat Malak
